# Vowz

> Beautiful wedding websites and digital invitations — RSVP management, photo galleries, event schedules, and custom domains for couples in India and abroad.

Vowz (by AXPIR Tech India LLP) lets couples create fully-branded wedding sites in minutes. Templates cover traditional Indian, regional, fusion, modern glam, destination, and minimal styles. Free forever plan with optional premium upgrades.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, hero, features, testimonials.
- [Features](/features): Full list of features — RSVP, gallery, budget, checklist, guestbook, custom domains, multi-language.
- [Templates](/templates): 25+ wedding invitation templates browsable by style, region, and vibe.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free plan, premium plans (monthly / 6-month / yearly), storage add-ons, regional INR/USD pricing.
- [Blog](/blog): Wedding-planning guides, invitation etiquette, product updates.
- [About](/about): The team behind Vowz — AXPIR Tech India LLP, founded by Anooj Xavier.
- [Contact](/contact): Support and business enquiries.
- [Affiliate program](/affiliate): 25% commission for wedding planners and creators.
